goal: Produce an evidence-first, operator-approved test plan for one controlled Forseti desktop integration slice without launching or driving the app.
prohibited_actions: run Tauri or desktop integration tests
use Accessibility, osascript, cliclick, or foreground-window automation
acceptance: Define the single integration claim to test and list the exact evidence that can support it; do not claim the desktop is safe.
Specify offline preflight checks, one-at-a-time execution boundaries, observable stop conditions, and a non-UI recovery path after a macOS stall.
Require explicit owner approval immediately before any UI launch; reboot alone is not approval and the safety lock remains ACTIVE.
List every prohibited automation path and state that no AX, mouse, keyboard, foreground-window, polling, or deploy mechanism is permitted.
Submit a Delivery Receipt with changed files, static validation, remaining unknowns, and an explicit statement that no UI action occurred.
done_definition: SUBMITTED only; Commander independently verifies the document before requesting owner approval.
